words.note: 當 withdraw 指軍隊、隊伍、公司或資源從原有位置、行動或承諾中向後撤、減少投入時，可用 pull back。它比 retreat 稍口語，也常用於商業或策略語境。
words.example: The troops were ordered to pull back before nightfall.
words.exampleZh: 部隊奉命在入夜前撤回。

exercises.original: The commander ordered the soldiers to withdraw to a safer position before dark.
exercises.zh: 指揮官命令士兵在天黑前撤到較安全的位置。
exercises.upgrade: pull back · 撤回；後撤；收縮

options.explanation: resign = 辭職。不是軍事撤退。
pull back = 後撤。soldiers + safer position 是典型戰術撤回。
retract = 撤回言論／聲明。不能自然指士兵移動。
take out = 取出／提取。語義不合。
drop out = 退出課程／比賽。不是部隊後撤。
step aside = 讓位／退居一旁。不是整隊撤離戰術位置。

exercises.original: The company decided to withdraw from several overseas markets after costs rose sharply.
exercises.zh: 成本大幅上升後，公司決定從幾個海外市場撤回業務。
exercises.upgrade: pull back · 撤回；後撤；收縮

options.explanation: retreat physically = 實體撤退。可比喻但不如 pull back 商業上自然。
retract a statement = 撤回聲明。語意不合。
take out cash = 提款。無關。
drop out of school = 輟學。無關。
pull back = 收縮／撤回。company + overseas markets + rising costs 是典型商業策略。
step aside = 讓位。通常是個人角色變動。

exercises.original: Investors began to withdraw from riskier assets as uncertainty increased.
exercises.zh: 不確定性上升後，投資者開始從較高風險資產中撤出。
exercises.upgrade: pull back · 撤回；後撤；收縮

options.explanation: pull back = 撤出／減少投入。investors + riskier assets 是自然金融語境。
drop out = 退出活動／課程。對資產配置不自然。
take out = 取出。若是具體提款才可。

words.note: 當 withdraw 明確指軍事、戰術或比喻性的『因壓力而退回』時，可用 retreat。它常帶有從較危險或較前線的位置退回的意味。
words.example: The army was forced to retreat across the river.

exercises.original: The troops had to withdraw after losing control of the eastern ridge.
exercises.zh: 部隊失去東部山脊控制權後不得不撤退。
exercises.upgrade: retreat · 撤退；退卻

options.explanation: step aside = 讓位。不是軍事後撤。
drop out = 退出活動。不是戰場用語。
retreat = 撤退。losing control of the ridge 是典型軍事撤退線索。

exercises.original: Facing overwhelming opposition, the unit withdrew into the hills.
exercises.zh: 面對壓倒性敵軍，該部隊撤退到山區。
exercises.upgrade: retreated · 撤退；退卻

options.explanation: pulled support = 撤回支持。不是部隊移動。
backed out = 反悔退出承諾。不是戰術撤退。
retreated = 撤退。overwhelming opposition + into the hills 是典型。

exercises.original: The rebels withdrew from the town when government forces arrived.
exercises.zh: 政府軍抵達時，叛軍撤離了城鎮。
exercises.upgrade: retreated · 撤退；退卻

options.explanation: dropped out = 退出課程／比賽。錯。
retreated = 撤退。government forces arrived 是典型軍事情境。

words.note: 當 withdraw 指公司、軍隊、投資者或組織完全退出某地、市場、項目或協議時，可用 pull out。它比 pull back 更有『整體離開』的意味。
words.example: The firm pulled out of the project after funding collapsed.
words.exampleZh: 資金告吹後，公司退出了該項目。

exercises.original: The sponsor decided to withdraw from the event completely after the dispute.
exercises.zh: 爭議發生後，贊助商決定完全退出活動。
exercises.upgrade: retreat · 退出；撤出

options.explanation: retract = 撤回言論。不是退出活動。
pull out = 完全退出。completely + sponsor + event 是典型。
step aside = 讓位。通常是個人角色。
retreat = 撤退。偏軍事或後撤。
resign = 辭職。贊助商不是職位。

exercises.original: The company withdrew from the deal at the last minute.
exercises.zh: 公司在最後一刻退出交易。
exercises.upgrade: retract · 退出；撤出

options.explanation: pull out = 退出。deal + at the last minute 是很自然的商業用法。
retract = 撤回聲明／言論。不是整個交易。
drop out = 常指退出課程／比賽。對 deal 不如 pull out 自然。
disengage physically = 脫離接觸。語體不合。

exercises.original: Several investors withdrew from the project after the financial forecast worsened.
exercises.zh: 財務預測惡化後，多名投資者退出了項目。
exercises.upgrade: pull out · 退出；撤出

options.explanation: pull out = 退出。investors + project + forecast worsened 是典型投資撤出。
step aside = 讓位。不是資金退出。
take out = 提取。若說 take money out 才可。
drop out of school = 輟學。無關。
retreat physically = 實體撤退。語境不合。

words.note: 當 withdraw 指某人中途退出課程、比賽、選舉、計劃或訓練時，可用 drop out。它通常暗示原本已參與，後來沒有完成。
words.example: Two runners dropped out before the final stage.
words.exampleZh: 兩名跑手在最後階段前退出比賽。

exercises.original: She withdrew from the course halfway through the semester because of family responsibilities.
exercises.zh: 她因家庭責任在學期中途退出課程。
exercises.upgrade: dropped out · 退出；中途離開

options.explanation: dropped out = 中途退出。course + halfway through the semester 是典型。
retreated = 撤退。不是教育語境。
stepped aside politically = 政治讓位。錯。

exercises.original: One candidate withdrew from the race before the final debate.
exercises.zh: 一名候選人在最後辯論前退出選舉。
exercises.upgrade: dropped out · 退出；中途離開

options.explanation: resigned from a job = 辭職。候選人不是辭去工作。
retracted a claim = 撤回主張。不是退出選舉。
backed out of a promise = 反悔。不是固定 race 用法。
dropped out = 退出競選。candidate + race 是自然用法。

exercises.original: Three athletes withdrew from the tournament after suffering injuries.
exercises.zh: 三名運動員受傷後退出錦標賽。
exercises.upgrade: dropped out · 退出；中途離開

options.explanation: retreated = 撤退。不是比賽用語。
dropped out = 中途退出。athletes + tournament + injuries 是典型。
stepped aside from office = 辭去職位。錯。

words.note: 當 withdraw 指某人原本答應、承諾或同意參與，後來反悔退出時，可用 back out。常見搭配是 back out of a deal / agreement / promise / plan。
words.example: He backed out of the agreement at the last moment.
words.exampleZh: 他在最後一刻退出協議。

exercises.original: She withdrew from the agreement after previously promising to take part.
exercises.zh: 她原本答應參與，後來卻退出協議。
exercises.upgrade: back out · 反悔退出；退出承諾

options.explanation: drop out = 中途退出活動／課程。可以接近，但 previously promising 更突出反悔。
back out = 反悔退出。agreement + previous promise 是典型。

exercises.original: The buyer withdrew from the deal just before signing the contract.
exercises.zh: 買家在簽約前一刻反悔退出交易。
exercises.upgrade: backed out · 反悔退出；退出承諾

options.explanation: backed out = 反悔退出。buyer + deal + just before signing 是典型。
dropped out of school = 輟學。無關。

exercises.original: He withdrew from the plan after saying for weeks that he would definitely join.
exercises.zh: 他連續幾星期說一定參加，最後卻退出計劃。
exercises.upgrade: backed out · 反悔退出；退出承諾

options.explanation: retracted = 撤回聲明。若撤回說法可用，但這裡是退出計劃。
backed out = 反悔退出。definitely join + later leaves plan 是直接線索。

words.note: 當 withdraw 是及物動詞，表示把某物從供應、展示、使用、支持或流通中移走時，可用 remove。它適合產品、資料、支持、部隊或物件等。
words.example: The company removed the product from sale.

exercises.original: The manufacturer withdrew the product from sale after a safety problem was discovered.
exercises.zh: 發現安全問題後，製造商把產品撤下市場。
exercises.upgrade: drop out · 移走；撤下；取消提供

options.explanation: take out = 取出。較口語，對 product from sale 不如 remove 正式自然。
remove = 撤下。product from sale + safety problem 是典型。

exercises.original: The organisation withdrew its logo from the campaign materials after the dispute.
exercises.zh: 爭議後，機構把自己的標誌從宣傳材料中撤下。
exercises.upgrade: remove · 移走；撤下；取消提供

options.explanation: take out = 取出。可以，但對 logo from campaign materials 不如 remove 精準。
remove = 移除。logo + campaign materials 是直接物件移除。
drop out = 退出。主語不是人參加活動。

exercises.original: The bank withdrew the outdated leaflet from all branches.
exercises.zh: 銀行把過時傳單從所有分行撤走。
exercises.upgrade: remove · 移走；撤下；取消提供

options.explanation: retract = 撤回言論。文件若是聲明可用，但實體 leaflet from branches 更自然是 remove。
remove = 移走。physical leaflet + branches 是典型。

words.note: 當 withdraw 特別指從銀行帳戶、提款機或容器中把金錢或某物取出時，可用 take out。對現金語境尤其常見、口語自然。
words.example: She took out two hundred dollars from the ATM.
words.exampleZh: 她從提款機提取了二百元。

exercises.original: I need to withdraw some cash before the shops close.
exercises.zh: 商店關門前，我需要提取一些現金。
exercises.upgrade: retreat · 取出；提取（款項）

options.explanation: take out = 提取。cash 是最典型的口語用法。

exercises.original: She withdrew fifty dollars from the ATM.
exercises.zh: 她從提款機提取了五十元。
exercises.upgrade: take out · 取出；提取（款項）

options.explanation: take out = 提取現金。ATM + fifty dollars 是直接線索。

exercises.original: Customers can withdraw up to five hundred dollars a day from this machine.
exercises.zh: 顧客每天可從這部機器提取最多五百元。
exercises.upgrade: take out · 取出；提取（款項）

options.explanation: pull back = 撤回／後撤。不是提款。
take out = 提取。machine + daily cash limit 是典型。

words.note: 當 withdraw 指公開收回、否認或不再堅持先前說過的話、聲明、指控或主張時，可用 retract。這是非常常見的正式替換。
words.example: The newspaper retracted the false claim.

exercises.original: The newspaper withdrew the allegation after discovering that the evidence was false.
exercises.zh: 報章發現證據不實後撤回了指控。
exercises.upgrade: retract · 撤回（聲明、指控、說法）

options.explanation: remove physically = 實體移除。不是收回主張。
retract = 撤回言論／指控。allegation + false evidence 是典型。

exercises.original: The witness later withdrew his earlier statement.
exercises.zh: 證人後來撤回了先前的陳述。
exercises.upgrade: retract · 撤回（聲明、指控、說法）

options.explanation: pull out = 退出項目／協議。不是收回陳述。
retract = 撤回陳述。statement 是典型搭配。

exercises.original: The scientist withdrew the claim after new data showed it was unsupported.
exercises.zh: 新數據顯示缺乏支持後，科學家撤回了該主張。
exercises.upgrade: retract · 撤回（聲明、指控、說法）

options.explanation: retract = 撤回主張。claim + unsupported data 是典型學術用法。
remove physically = 實體移除。不是收回主張。

words.meaning: 讓位；退出競逐；退居一旁
words.note: 當 withdraw 指某人主動退出領導、競選、職位競逐或決策角色，讓其他人接手時，可用 step aside。它常帶較體面、主動讓位的語感。
words.example: The candidate stepped aside to allow a younger colleague to run.
words.exampleZh: 候選人讓位，讓較年輕的同事參選。

exercises.original: The candidate withdrew from the leadership contest and endorsed another colleague.
exercises.zh: 候選人退出領導競逐，並支持另一名同事。
exercises.upgrade: remove · 讓位；退出競逐；退居一旁

options.explanation: step aside = 讓位／退出競逐。candidate + leadership contest + endorsed another colleague 是典型。
remove = 移除。通常需有外力主語。
drop out of school = 輟學。無關。

exercises.original: After criticism of his handling of the issue, he withdrew from the committee chair role.
exercises.zh: 因處理事件受到批評後，他退出委員會主席職務。
exercises.upgrade: step aside · 讓位；退出競逐；退居一旁

options.explanation: step aside = 讓位。chair role + criticism 是自然領導角色語境。
retreat = 撤退。可以比喻但不如 step aside 體面自然。
drop out = 中途退出活動。對領導職位不如 step aside。

exercises.original: She withdrew as team leader so another member could take over.
exercises.zh: 她退出隊長角色，讓另一名成員接手。
exercises.upgrade: step aside · 讓位；退出競逐；退居一旁

options.explanation: step aside = 讓位。so another member could take over 是最直接線索。
remove = 移除。通常不是主動自我退出。
back out = 反悔退出承諾。若原本答應才較合適。

words.meaning: 脫離；解除參與；退出接觸
words.note: 當 withdraw 指從衝突、談判、行動、關係或接觸中逐步脫離時，可用 disengage。它較正式，常見於軍事、外交、心理或組織語境。
words.example: Both sides agreed to disengage from the confrontation.
words.exampleZh: 雙方同意從對峙中脫離。

exercises.original: The two sides agreed to withdraw from direct confrontation and reduce contact.
exercises.zh: 雙方同意退出直接對峙並減少接觸。
exercises.upgrade: drop out · 脫離；解除參與；退出接觸

options.explanation: retreat only = 只是撤退。可能是軍事移動，但 reduce contact 更像 disengagement。
remove = 移除。不是雙方主動脫離關係。
disengage = 脫離接觸。direct confrontation + reduce contact 是典型。
drop out = 退出活動。語體不合。

exercises.original: The organisation began to withdraw from the negotiations after months of little progress.
exercises.zh: 數月幾乎沒有進展後，該組織開始退出談判。
exercises.upgrade: disengage · 脫離；解除參與；退出接觸

options.explanation: back out suddenly = 突然反悔退出。題目是 begun to withdraw，較像逐步脫離。
disengage = 逐步退出參與。negotiations + months of little progress 是自然正式語境。
retract a statement = 撤回聲明。錯。
remove an object = 移走物件。錯。

exercises.original: The country is gradually withdrawing from the security operation while transferring duties to local forces.
exercises.zh: 該國正逐步退出安全行動，同時把職責移交本地部隊。
exercises.upgrade: retract · 脫離；解除參與；退出接觸

options.explanation: drop out = 退出活動。太口語且不適合國家安全行動。
retreat suddenly = 突然撤退。和 gradually 相反。
step aside socially = 社交上讓位。錯。
disengage = 逐步脫離。gradually + transfer duties 是典型正式退出。

words.meaning: 正式撤回；撤銷（決定、要約、政策）
words.note: 當 withdraw 指正式撤回或撤銷一項已提出的要約、決定、許可或政策時，可用 rescind。它是法律、商業和行政語境中的正式詞。
words.example: The company rescinded the offer before the contract was signed.
words.exampleZh: 合約簽署前，公司撤回了要約。

exercises.original: The employer withdrew the job offer after discovering that the information provided was false.
exercises.zh: 僱主發現資料不實後正式撤回工作要約。
exercises.upgrade: retreat · 正式撤回；撤銷（決定、要約、政策）

options.explanation: rescind = 正式撤回／撤銷。job offer + employer + formal decision 是典型。
retract speech only = 撤回言論。job offer 更正式自然用 rescind。

exercises.original: The council withdrew its earlier approval after new safety evidence emerged.
exercises.zh: 新安全證據出現後，市議會撤銷了較早的批准。
exercises.upgrade: drop out · 正式撤回；撤銷（決定、要約、政策）

options.explanation: retract statement = 撤回聲明。approval 是行政決定，不只是言論。
rescind = 正式撤銷。council approval + new evidence 是典型行政用語。

exercises.original: The bank withdrew the loan offer before the customer accepted it.
exercises.zh: 客戶接受前，銀行正式撤回了貸款要約。
exercises.upgrade: rescind · 正式撤回；撤銷（決定、要約、政策）

options.explanation: rescind = 正式撤回。loan offer + before acceptance 是典型商業法律語境。
take out = 提取。若是 take out a loan 反而表示借款，不是撤回要約。
remove an object = 移走物件。錯。

falseSynonyms.zh: 暫不給予；扣留不等於一般的 withdraw withhold 表示從一開始就不給、暫時保留或扣住；withdraw 通常表示原本已提供、已參與或已提出，之後再撤回。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You withhold something before giving it; you withdraw something after it has been offered or committed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 取消不等於一般的 withdraw cancel 常指令活動、預約、服務或計劃不再發生；withdraw 可以只是某一方退出，而活動本身仍繼續。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person may withdraw from an event without the event being cancelled.

falseSynonyms.zh: 離開不等於一般的 withdraw leave 是非常廣泛的『離開』；withdraw 通常帶有正式退出、撤回、後撤或取出等更具體語義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Leave describes departure generally; withdraw often carries a more specific institutional or strategic sense.

falseSynonyms.zh: 辭職不等於一般的 withdraw resign 特指辭去職位或工作；withdraw 可以退出比賽、撤回聲明、提款、撤軍等，範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Resigning is one specific way of leaving a role, not a general synonym for withdraw.

falseSynonyms.zh: 拒絕不等於一般的 withdraw reject 是拒絕接受某物或某提議；withdraw 是提出或參與之後再撤回。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You reject an offer you do not accept; you withdraw an offer you previously made.

falseSynonyms.zh: 拒絕不等於一般的 withdraw refuse 表示不願做、不接受或不給予；它不是把已經做出的承諾、聲明或參與撤回。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Refusing prevents an action; withdrawing reverses or ends an existing one.

falseSynonyms.zh: 疏散；撤離不等於一般的 withdraw evacuate 通常指把人從危險地區移走，或人員撤離危險地帶；withdraw 可有軍事撤退含義，但用途更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Evacuation is specifically about leaving danger; withdrawal has many other senses.

falseSynonyms.zh: 逆轉；改變決定不等於一般的 withdraw reverse 指把方向、結果或決定反過來；withdraw 可能只是撤回，不一定把原決定改成相反結果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A decision can be withdrawn without being reversed into its opposite.
